lines.text: Rockstar may have shown us GTA 6 back in 2021.
Remember the San Andreas remaster? A framed picture hung on a bar wall.
Fans always said it looked like a leaked GTA 6 screenshot.
Now players say they found that exact house in Leonida.
Same garage, same palm trees, even the bushes match.
It sits in Belville, and the GTA Wiki mapping project found it.
One outlet says the new version has far more detail.
Rockstar has not said a word.
So was it a secret teaser, or just a lucky coincidence? Tell us below, do you think
